name: Bone Tumours and Metabolic Bone Disease

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Malignant osteoid mineralises sunbursts while EWS-FLI1 arrests neural crest into round blue sheets; RANKL giant cells resorb epiphyses expansively, and chaotic Paget remodelling mosaics cement lines sarcomatising rarely.
additionalDifferentials: Osteosarcoma versus Ewing by age, site and matrix
GCT versus ABC by age, epiphysis and fluid levels
Paget versus metastasis by mosaic and ALP pattern
additionalInvestigations: X-ray sunburst or onion skin with MRI staging in bone pain
Biopsy tract planned with limb salvage team in sarcoma
ALP with DEXA and calcium in elderly bone pain
